test_title: PYST 37: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Ram spends 30% of his monthly salary on food, and one-fifth of the remaining on house rent. If Ram saves Rs. 7,000 per month, which is equal to one-third of the balance after spending on food and house rent, then what is his monthly salary(approximately)?
solution:
**Given**

30% spending on food

one fifth of the remaining on rent=(1)/(5)times 70=14%% of total

savings =7000 which is one third of balance after food and rent

**Calculation**

total spending=30+14=44%

balance=100-44=56%

one third of the 56% is 7000=(1)/(3)×56=18.667%

so 18.667%=7000Rs

total income is 100%=(7000)/(18.667)×100=37499.33 approximately equal to 37500

**The monthly income of Ram is 37500Rs**
